computation.homogeneity_assumption: Arithmetic/harmonic means are homogeneous under a common positive scalar factor; recognised with at most eight binary64 ulps per constituent. Selected scenarios are replayed through actual tool calls.
computation.tool_response_scope: All phase composition/modulus responses, selected candidate scenarios, nominal pure-matrix/single-ceramic controls and the highest nominal margin candidate; grid envelopes are not retained.

assumptions: Linear isotropic consolidated-phase proxies, perfect elastic bonding, zero porosity, retained supplied phases and no residual stress.
Thermal conductivity bounds assume perfect Fourier contact; interfaces can invalidate their use as lower bounds on fabricated specimens.
Volume-average and Turner CTE are alternative proxies, not rigorous bounds; source temperature intervals differ.
Consolidated-grade and substrate data are not verified powder or composite properties; additives/impurities ignored in formula-based elemental estimates.
Source and stress scenarios are deterministic comparisons, not statistical confidence intervals or calibrated prediction uncertainty.
No phase stability, reaction kinetics, strength, toughness, fatigue, cost, fabrication feasibility, or chemical novelty is predicted.

curated_inputs.data_reuse: Small factual property subset with source attribution; no open redistribution license asserted and full supplier tables/PDFs are not redistributed.
curated_inputs.purpose: Generate model-ranked lightweight stiff heat-spreader composite recipes for experimental validation; no established chemical novelty or synthesizability.

sources.evidence: Handbook-backed secondary table; ambient approximately 20°C unless stated, CTE at 25°C and conductivity at 27°C. Independently listed K/G values are omitted because they are inconsistent with the selected E and nu.

limitations: Screening hypothesis only: ideal dense, isotropic, perfectly bonded mixtures. No phase stability, interfacial chemistry, porosity, microstructure, manufacturing, temperature dependence, experimental performance, or literature novelty is established. The two CTE estimates are model proxies, not rigorous bounds.

nominated_candidate.recipe_assumption: Pure stoichiometric phase formulas; grade additives, binders, impurities and interfacial reactions are omitted.

nomination_rule: Nominal feasible candidates ranked by least ceramic volume loading, then highest harmonic conductivity, then highest Reuss specific modulus, then ordered volume percentages.
